name: Bloom Druid
body:
Because of Freyja’s connection to fertility and abundance, many druids are members of Freyja’s cult. Bloom druids, called Succulents by commoners, celebrate the proliferation of new life in the Spring in both the plant and animal kingdoms. They also celebrate beauty in all of its forms—the curves of a woman’s body, the delicate petals of a rose, the uniqueness of a snowflake, the scent of fresh strawberries.

These druids serve their communities as arborists, farmers, and herbalists. Some specialize in husbandry overseeing the births of cattle and other livestock. Bloom druids hold a yearly meeting in the Spring to exchange seeds, share herbal remedies for various ailments, and discuss best practices in husbandry.

Nature Bond (Ex)

At 1st level, a bloom druid adds the Charm cleric domain to the list of domains available to her for her nature bond class ability. This alters nature bond.

Abundant Pheromones (Ex)

The pheromones a bloom druid exudes make humanoids more likely to be agreeable towards them. At 1st level, a bloom druid gains a circumstance bonus equal to 1/2 her druid level on Diplomacy checks made against humanoids.

This replaces wild empathy.

Spells: At 1st level, a bloom druid can decide to use her Charisma as her spellcasting ability modifier instead of her Wisdom. This is an optional ability, but once the decision is made at 1st level, the choice is final and can’t be changed. This potentially alters spells.

Cup Overfloweth (Ex)

Starting at 3rd level, whenever a bloom druid casts a summon nature’s ally spell and chooses an option that relies on a d3 or d4 roll, she always treats the die roll as the highest possible result. For example, a 3rd level bloom druid casts summon nature’s ally II. If she selects the 1d3 1st-level Creatures option, she automatically gets 3. This replaces trackless step and venom immunity.

Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Freyja, © 2023, Bloodstone Press; Author P. C. Graves and Beth Jones
